decision_conditions:
<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>NHD/02522/001, NHD/02522/002, NHD/02522/003, Design and Access Statement;&nbsp;Noise
Impact Assessment [ref: 1908252 Rev 0, dated 29/09/2025]&nbsp;</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those stated in supporting documents.&nbsp;

<div>An Odour Impact Assessment, including&nbsp;odour control and filtration measures,&nbsp; is to be submitted and approved&nbsp;by
the Local Planning Authority&nbsp;prior to installation of the approved extraction system or prior to the premises being brought into first use whichever is sooner.&nbsp;The flue system and associated mitigation measures shall be so installed, used and thereafter retained as approved to prevent the transmission of noise, vibration, and odour/fume into any neighbouring premises.</div>

<div>The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:-&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><div>(a) 11:00 hours to 23:00 hours, Monday to Saturday inclusive,</div><div><br></div><div>(b) 11:00 hours to 23:00 hours on Sundays and Bank Holidays</div><div><br></div><div>without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</div>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be brought into until a Fire Safety Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><ol><li>Information on space provisions for fire appliances and assembly points;</li><li>Information on passive and active safety measures;</li><li>Information and data on construction materials;</li><li>Information on means of escape and escape strategy; and</li><li>Information on access and equipment for firefighting.</li></ol><p>&nbsp;The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span data-teams="true"></span></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the fire safety of the proposed building is managed in a satisfactory manner and that the development contributes to fire safety in line with Policy D12A of the London Plan (2021). To ensure appropriate fire safety measures are approved before development commences on site.&nbsp;</p>
